subject: Post-show ROI traceback: NimbleHealth pipeline attribution
messages:
From: Alex Martinez <alex_martinez@redwood.ai>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>, Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.ai>
Cc: EventOps <events@eventops.co>
Date: 2026-10-01T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Post-show ROI traceback: NimbleHealth pipeline attribution

Team —

Following SaaSScale (Sep 24–25) we’ve got a crediting question from NimbleHealth (they surfaced $1.2M influenced pipeline that isn’t showing in HubSpot under their Campaign attribution). I pulled the initial list from EventOps but we need to reconcile on: UTM mapping, demo-to-opportunity linkage, and whether any direct inbound leads were mis-tagged.

Please review the attached export (nimble_leads_q3_summits.csv) and the UTM mapping we used for the show (saaSscale-utm-mapping.xlsx). Key asks:
- Marissa: confirm which leads were marked as "Event: SaaSScale" vs. "Organic" in our campaign logic.
- Ben: audit the demo->opp touches for the 12 contacts in the CSV that Sam called out (HubSpot IDs in column D).
- Lauren: check any contract/redline that could affect crediting on deals (I’ve attached the current redlines).

We’ve got Sam Patel from Nimble on Cc from EventOps; they expect an answer this week. I want a short readout and a recommendation for a single record-level fix (if feasible) or a manual crediting plan.

—Alex
Alex Martinez
Sr. Director, Field Marketing | Redwood Inference

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
To: Alex Martinez <alex_martinez@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>, Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-10-02T11:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Post-show ROI traceback: NimbleHealth pipeline attribution

Thanks Alex — quick summary of what I found after a first pass:

- EventOps export contains 78 Nimble-related rows; 14 were deduped to existing contacts (good).
- Of the remaining 64, 49 have UTM_campaign = "saasscale-2026" which maps to our campaign id CS-2026-SC. 15 have blank or mismatched UTMs (mostly direct links captured at the demo kiosk).
- The 12 HubSpot IDs Alex flagged: 9 show the event touch as a note only (no campaign property set) because kiosk flows saved as "note" rather than updating contact properties.

Recommendation: For the 9 contacts with notes-only event mentions, we can run a property backfill that sets "First Touch Campaign" = CS-2026-SC and add a "Event Source" custom field. This is reversible and preserves original timelines. For the 15 with blank UTMs, we should map by email match and set a secondary "Attribution Source" but flag those as lower confidence.

I attached the mapping workbook with a proposed column we can push to HubSpot. If everyone agrees, I can kick off the import and tag a sample 10 contacts for QA before bulk run.

Attachments referenced: saaSscale-utm-mapping.xlsx, nimble_leads_q3_summits.csv

—Marissa
Marissa Cole
Head of Field Marketing | Redwood Inference

From: Sam Patel <s.patel@nimblehealth.com>
To: Alex Martinez <alex_martinez@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-10-04T08:21:00-04:00
Subject: Re: Post-show ROI traceback: NimbleHealth pipeline attribution

Alex — thanks for flagging. We see $1.2M in influenced opps on our side tied to demo conversations at SaaSScale (HubSpot owner: Anika Rao). Those opps are showing "Event: SaaSScale" in our internal fields. Nimble is expecting Redwood to credit the leads to the summit (our CSM is pushing for priority on renewals if the credit is applied).

Two quick asks from us:
1) Can you confirm whether Redwood will do a retroactive property update if the leads are clearly tied to the kiosk demos?
2) If not, we need documented evidence of why those opps were not attributed (we’ll share the opp IDs if helpful).

Happy to hop on a 20-min call tomorrow (Oct 5) to walk through specific HubSpot records.

Thanks —
Sam Patel
Head of Partnerships | NimbleHealth

From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
To: Sam Patel <s.patel@nimblehealth.com>, Alex Martinez <alex_martinez@redwood.ai>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-10-05T09:37:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Post-show ROI traceback: NimbleHealth pipeline attribution

Hi Sam — thanks for the note and for sharing the concern. Quick technical context: our kiosk flow writes a free-text note and (in many cases) the attendant forgets to hit the "Update contact" button that writes the campaign property. That’s why some contacts show a demo note but no campaign property.

We can do a retroactive property update for records with a clear email match and demo timestamp inside the event window — that’s our preferred remediation. Steps I propose:
- Marissa to provide the canonical list of contacts + event timestamps (she’s prepared the CSV).
- I’ll run a scoped HubSpot import to backfill "First Touch Campaign" = CS-2026-SC for matched contacts (we’ll log the change and add an "Attribution Confidence" flag).
- We’ll notify your CSM and provide an exported log you can ingest into your CRM for reconciliation.

If you want, we can take the 20-min call tomorrow at 11:00 AM ET to validate a sample set before the import.

Ben Carter
Enterprise AE | Redwood Inference

From: Alex Martinez <alex_martinez@redwood.ai>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>, Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.ai>, Sam Patel <s.patel@nimblehealth.com>
Date: 2026-10-07T15:47:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Post-show ROI traceback: NimbleHealth pipeline attribution — agreed plan

Hi all — quick readout and next steps after the call:

Summary:
- Root cause: kiosk flow rarely set campaign properties; notes were captured but not mapped to the campaign property.
- Impact: 12 Nimble-related contacts (9 high-confidence email matches, 3 low-confidence) were missing the CS-2026-SC tag.

Action items (owners & timing):
- Marissa: QA the list and confirm the 9 high-confidence contacts by 10/08 COB. (Attachment: nimble_leads_q3_summits.csv - highlighted rows)
- Ben: Run the scoped HubSpot import to set "First Touch Campaign" = CS-2026-SC for the 9 confirmed contacts and flag "Attribution Confidence" = high. Run Thursday 10/09 AM and share the import log.
- Lauren: Work with Legal to confirm that retroactive crediting for these contacts is OK given existing contract language; escalate any redline concerns by 10/09 EOD (attachment: nimble_contract_redlines.pdf).
- Alex: Provide NimbleHealth and their CSM the import log and a one-page summary for their records. I’ll include a DocuSign link for the agreed closure statement if they want formal sign-off.

Sam — thanks for the call and patience. We’ll share the import log and a reconciliation CSV after Ben’s job runs; if you want formal sign-off we can route a short acknowledgement via DocuSign: https://www.docusign.com/en/link/REDACTED-abcdef

Closing note: operational fix is to update kiosk flow and add an automated write to campaign property; Marissa is taking that as a quarterly ops project.

—Alex
Alex Martinez
Sr. Director, Field Marketing | Redwood Inference
Attachments referenced: nimble_leads_q3_summits.csv, saaSscale-utm-mapping.xlsx, nimble_contract_redlines.pdf
